frame.search: Search by plate, model or name

signIn.intro: SNS Rent a Car · Elpitiya. Sign in to your account.
signIn.help: Forgot your password? Ask the owner to reset it. 5 wrong tries lock the account for 15 minutes.
signIn.everyone: Owner, admin, staff and partners each have their own account.
signIn.wrong: The phone number or the password is wrong.
signIn.locked: The account is locked after 5 wrong tries. Try again in 15 minutes.
signIn.phoneInvalid: This is not a Sri Lankan mobile number. Type the 10 digits, starting 070, 071, 072, 074, 075, 076, 077 or 078.
signIn.passwordShort: Passwords have at least 8 characters. Check what you typed.
signIn.resetDone: Your new password is saved. Sign in with it.

firstSignIn.title: Your password
firstSignIn.subtitle: First sign-in
firstSignIn.intro: This is your first sign-in. Choose your own password to replace the one you were given.
firstSignIn.rule: At least 8 characters. If you forget it, the owner resets it.
firstSignIn.notSame: The two passwords are not the same.

settings.title: Settings
settings.peopleNote: Nobody shares an account. Every action is saved under the name of the person signed in, even though staff share one cash drawer. When someone leaves, open their row and turn the account off, with a reason: sign-in stops, and their name stays on everything they recorded.
settings.partnersLater: Partner owners get their account when they are added on Partners.

add.title: Add a person
add.name: Name
add.passwordHint: You type it and give it to the person by hand. They change it at their first sign-in.
add.adminHint: Approvals and partner cash-outs by default
add.partnerHint: Added with the partner, on Partners: one account for all their cars
add.defaultsHint: You can change them for this person after saving, on the Permissions page.
add.footer: Give the first password to the person by hand; nothing is sent. Saving is recorded in the activity log.
add.emailHint: Sign-in codes on a new device and the password reset link go here. It counts once the admin types the code sent to it.

person.ownerNote: The primary owner can do everything. The owner resets their own password by email (Forgot your password? on the sign-in page).
person.resetHint: When {name} forgets the password. They are signed out everywhere and change it at their next sign-in.
person.newPasswordHint: You type it and give it to {name} by hand. At least 8 characters.
person.resetDone: Done. Give the new first password to {name} by hand.
person.offHint: When {name} leaves. Sign-in stops at once. Everything {name} recorded keeps the name. You can turn it back on.
person.onHint: Turning it back on lets {name} sign in again with the same password.
person.logNote: Every change is recorded in the activity log.
person.emailHint: Sign-in codes on a new device and the password reset link go to this email. Only the owner and the admin have one.
person.newEmailHint: Codes keep going to the old email until the code sent to the new one is typed in at the next sign-in.
person.emailSaved: Saved. It counts once the code sent to it is typed in.

permissionsPage.lock: Only the primary owner can change these, add people or turn accounts off; those three cannot be given to anyone. The owner can do everything and is not listed.
permissionsPage.authorisedHint: Not set yet: only the owner until given to someone.
permissionsPage.selfApproval: Nobody approves their own request; another approver must. The owner's own is marked "self-approved".
permissionsPage.noPeople: No admin or staff yet. Add people first.

errors.phoneInvalid: This is not a Sri Lankan mobile number. Type the 10 digits, starting 070, 071, 072, 074, 075, 076, 077 or 078.
errors.phoneTaken: Someone already has this phone number.
errors.reasonMissing: Write why the account is turned off.
errors.notAllowed: Only the primary owner can do this.
errors.emailInvalid: This does not look like an email address.
errors.emailTaken: Someone else already has this email.
errors.notSent: The email could not be sent. Try again.

perms.proceedDespiteFlag: Go ahead despite a customer flag
perms.sharePartnerCarSurcharge: Share an above-package price on a partner car
perms.changePriceOrDiscount: Change an agreed price or give a discount
perms.reduceEarlyReturnCharges: Reduce charges for an early return
perms.overrideExpiredDocuments: Go ahead with expired insurance or licence
perms.payPartnerCashouts: Pay partner cash-outs and record them
perms.editCarsAndPackages: Add or edit cars and packages
perms.markCarUnavailable: Mark a car under repair or unavailable

forbidden.title: Not for this account
forbidden.body: Your account does not have permission for this page. Ask the owner if you need it.

rules.ownerNote: Only the owner changes these. Admin and staff see them here.
rules.footer: Every rule under “Set now” is agreed by the owner; changing the owner settings here is proposed, for the owner to confirm. A new rule is recorded in the system design before it appears here. Each change to an owner setting is in the activity log, with the old and new values.

dayTimes.title: Rental day times
dayTimes.note: a pickup before the cutoff ends at the next morning’s deadline · a change applies to new rentals only

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.note: insurance and licence · service (date or km) · payroll

fuel.title: Fuel price
fuel.note: per litre, for a “same level” rental

pickupCutoff.label: Pickup cutoff
pickupCutoff.hint: A pickup at or after this time starts the next rental day.

returnDeadline.label: Return deadline
returnDeadline.hint: The car is due back by this time in the morning.

intro.dayTimes: Times are in Sri Lanka time. A change applies to new rentals only; rentals already agreed keep their times.
intro.reminders: How early each reminder starts. Only the owner can change this.
intro.fuel: Charged only on a “same level” rental, for the litres missing at return. 100% SNS.

rules.logNote: Saving is recorded in the activity log with the old and new values.

errors.number: Type a whole number, digits only.
errors.notAllowed: Only the owner can change settings.
errors.stale: Someone saved a change here meanwhile. Open the page again to see it, then make your change.

extraKm.title: Extra km
extraKm.note: beyond the km included · 17 to 27 a km by type

fuel.title: Fuel
fuel.note: not counted by default · “same level” for one rental: missing litres × price per litre

businessDay.title: Business day
businessDay.note: staff close it after the evening count; otherwise it closes at 11:59 PM

drawerCount.title: Drawer count
drawerCount.note: staff see the expected cash, then type what they count

cashOut.title: Cash out of the drawer
cashOut.note: partner payouts, salary and owner withdrawals · each its own line, never an expense

bankCheck.title: Bank and card check
bankCheck.note: a payment waits up to 3 days for the statement, then is flagged · card fees entered monthly

expiredDocuments.title: Expired insurance or licence
expiredDocuments.note: warns staff; going ahead needs an authorised person and a reason

plannedService.title: Planned service
plannedService.note: any garage visit, planned or not

lateReturn.title: Late return
lateReturn.note: no fee runs on its own

partnerCashOut.title: Partner cash-out
partnerCashOut.note: earnings final at the day’s close · to the bank or in cash at the branch · no limits

garageDay.title: Garage-day charge
garageDay.note: only for damage during the rental · staff propose the days, an admin approves

payrollDeductions.title: Payroll deductions
payrollDeductions.note: never take a salary below zero; the rest carries to next month

money.title: Money
money.note: whole rupees · a partner’s share rounds down, SNS takes the difference; a correction is the exact mirror of its line

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.note: nobody approves their own request; the owner’s own is marked “self-approved”

affects: How many days a new rental is charged: a pickup before the cutoff ends at the next morning’s deadline; a pickup at or after it, the morning after.
When a new rental’s car is due back. After the deadline it is a late return, and staff decide any charge, with a reason.
Rentals already agreed, and their phone extensions, keep the times they were agreed with.
before: Try a few pickup times near the new cutoff: a pickup may now be charged one day more or one day less.
Tell staff the new times before the next pickup.

affects: When insurance and revenue licence renewals, services (by date or by km, whichever comes first) and payroll start to show in Upcoming work.
Only when a reminder starts. No date, charge or car changes.
before: A shorter time leaves less time to renew. When insurance or a revenue licence has expired, staff are warned, and going ahead needs an authorised person and a reason.
A longer time shows reminders earlier, so Upcoming work gets longer.

affects: Only rentals set to “same level”: the litres missing at return × this price go on the bill, all for SNS. Staff can waive it with a reason.
By default fuel is not counted, so most rentals do not use this price.
Rentals already agreed keep the price from when they were agreed.
before: Check today’s pump price. Whole rupees only.
Tell staff the new price: they explain the fuel charge to the customer at return.

code.title: Sign-in code
code.subtitle: New device
code.heading: Code from your email
code.intro: This device is new for this account. We sent a 6-digit code to your email. It works once, for 10 minutes.
code.device: After the right code, this device is remembered for 30 days; each sign-in here starts the 30 days again. A new phone, another browser or cleared browser data asks for a code again.

errors.codeWrong: That code is not right. Check the email and try again.
errors.codeExpired: This code has run out (10 minutes). Ask for a new one.
errors.codeTooMany: 5 wrong codes: this code has stopped. Ask for a new one.
errors.locked: The account is locked after 5 wrong tries. Try again in 15 minutes.
errors.tooSoon: Wait a minute before asking for a new code.
errors.notSent: The email could not be sent. Try again in a minute, or ask the owner.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.subtitle: Email link
forgot.heading: Forgot your password?
forgot.intro: For the owner and the admin: type your phone number. If it has a confirmed email, we send a link to set a new password.
forgot.sent: If this number has an email, a link was sent. It works once, for 1 hour.
forgot.staff: Staff and partners: ask the owner to reset your password.

reset.title: New password
reset.subtitle: Email link
reset.heading: New password
reset.intro: From the link in your email (it works once, for 1 hour). Choose a new password.
reset.rule: At least 8 characters. Saving signs you out everywhere else.

errors.notSame: The two passwords are not the same.
errors.linkOld: This link is old or already used. Ask for a new one.

confirmEmail.title: Confirm your email
confirmEmail.subtitle: Email
confirmEmail.heading: Confirm your new email
confirmEmail.intro: The owner changed your email to {email}. Send a code to it and type it here. Until you confirm, sign-in codes still go to your old email.
confirmEmail.sent: A code was sent to your new email.
confirmEmail.notMine: Not your email? Choose Later and ask the owner to correct it. The change is in the activity log.

errors.codeExpired: This code has run out. Send a new one.
errors.codeTooMany: 5 wrong codes: send a new one.
errors.codeTooSoon: Wait a minute before sending a new code.
errors.notFound: There is no new email to confirm.
errors.emailTaken: Someone else already has this email. Ask the owner.
errors.notSent: The email could not be sent. Try again.

cars.title: Cars
cars.listNote: Prices are each car’s own package. A new car starts with its model’s starting package.
cars.termsNote: Changes apply to new rentals only.
cars.saved: Saved. New rentals use the new terms.

garageDayCharge.label: Garage-day charge
garageDayCharge.hint: only for damage during a rental · admin approves
garageDayCharge.name: garage-day charge

cars.packageFrom: {model} starting package · can be changed for this car
cars.partnerNote: Shown only to people who may see partner terms; changed only by people who may add or edit partners. Who pays which costs is agreed when the partner is added.
cars.newRentalsOnly: Changes apply to new rentals only. Rentals already running, and their extensions, keep the terms they started with.
cars.registrationHint: One car per number, as written on the plate.
cars.modelHint: A model not listed is added on Starting packages first, with its own package.
cars.partnerHint: linked to its owner on Partners › Add a partner
after: The car is on All cars as Available.
A partner car shows “Partner · not linked yet” until its owner is added on Partners.
Papers, service dates and the photo are added on the car’s page.
cars.changesEmpty: No changes since the car was added.

errors.registrationInvalid: Letters, numbers, spaces and - only, as on the plate.
errors.registrationTaken: This number is already a car. Open it from All cars.
errors.invalid: Type a whole number in the range.
errors.stale: Someone changed this car meanwhile. Open the page again to see it, then make your change.

ownerPays.label: Owner pays for
ownerPays.name: costs the owner pays
ownerPays.note: Anything not ticked is decided case by case by the admin.

partners.title: Partner owners
partners.unlinkedTitle: Partner cars not linked to an owner
partners.unlinkedNote: Each partner gets one account for all their cars. Every partner car is linked to its owner before go-live.
partners.unlinkedNone: Every partner car has its owner.
partners.accountNote: One account for every car. {name} sees final earnings and cash-outs only; never today’s not-final amounts, other partners or customers’ details.
partners.nicHint: As on the card: 9 digits and V or X, or 12 digits.
partners.name: Name
partners.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. Give it to the partner by hand; they change it when they first sign in. Nothing is sent.
partners.bankHint: Optional. Without it, cash-outs are paid in cash at the branch.
partners.bankNone: No bank account · cash-outs in cash at the branch
partners.chooseCarsHint: Partner cars not linked to an owner yet. One account covers every car chosen.
partners.noFreeCars: No partner cars are waiting for an owner. Add the car first on Cars, as Partner.
partners.perDayNote: Per day {rate} · set on the car, not here.
after: The partner gets a first password to change when they sign in.
The partner agreement is printed once the owner approves its wording. It is signed on paper; the date is recorded on the partner's page.
partners.agreementNote: Printed, signed and kept on paper. Nothing waits on it.
partners.notSigned: Not yet recorded as signed · cash-outs are not held back.
partners.printLater: Printing comes once the owner approves the agreement wording.
partners.startingBalance: The starting balance owed on go-live day is loaded with the starting data.

errors.phoneInvalid: A Sri Lankan mobile number, 10 digits, starting 07.
errors.phoneTaken: This phone number already has an account.
errors.nicInvalid: 9 digits and V or X, or 12 digits, as on the card.
errors.nicTaken: A partner with this NIC is already recorded.
errors.carsInvalid: Each chosen car needs a commission from 0 to 100%.
errors.carNotFree: One of these cars was just linked to someone else. Open the page again.
errors.dateInvalid: Choose a date, not in the future.

partners.addCarHint: Partner cars not linked to an owner yet. Each one gets its commission and the costs the owner pays.
partners.noFreeCarsHere: No partner cars are waiting for an owner. Add the car first on Cars, as Partner.
partners.signIn: Sign-in: reset password, turn off or on

customers.title: Customers
customers.firstNote: People with an expired licence come first; people who owe money or are flagged join them once rentals run.
customers.name: Name
customers.nicHint: As on the card: 9 digits and V or X, or 12 digits. A NIC already recorded opens that customer.
customers.phoneHint: 9 to 15 digits; a + at the start for a foreign number.
customers.licenceNote: If the licence has expired, everyone sees a warning before renting to this customer.
customers.copiesNote: A photo (JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC) or PDF, up to 10 MB each, kept as taken. Only people with customer access can open these copies, and each opening is recorded. Make sure every number is clear.
customers.copiesLater: Copies can be added later; handover waits for them.
customers.referenceNote: Decided for each rental, when staff think one is needed. Their NIC and licence copies are then added with the rental.
customers.existing: This NIC is already a customer. Here they are; nothing new was saved.
customers.licenceWarning: The driving licence expired on {date}. Everyone sees a warning before renting to this customer.
customers.flagsLater: Flags and money owed show here once they come in.

errors.nicInvalid: 9 digits and V or X, or 12 digits, as on the card.
errors.phoneInvalid: 9 to 15 digits; a + at the start for a foreign number.
errors.fileType: Only a photo (JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC) or a PDF.
errors.stale: Someone changed this customer meanwhile. Open the page again to see it, then make your change.
